newsitem.title: USA: American Real Estate says SEC approves offer. [CORRECTED 15:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: American Real Estate says SEC approves offer. [CORRECTED 15:47 GMT]

text.p: American Real Estate Partners LP said Friday that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has declared effective its proposed rights offering registration statement.

American Real Estate Partners said in a statement that under the terms of the pricing, holders of record at the end of business today, Aug 8, of its depository units will be entitled to recieve one right for each five depository units held.

These rights, the company said, entitle the holders to purchase four depository units and one 5 percent cumulative pay-in-kind redeemable preferred unit for $52. The purchases can be made at any time prior to a 1700 EST/2200 GMT New York time deadline on Sept 11 (corrects from Sep 5).
The company said it anticipates that certificates allowing unit holders (rights) to subscribe, together with a prospectus, will be mailed to them by Aug 13.
